notes: The source URL and text are for the Accounting Associate in Science Degree (Major Code 02011, Total Units 37), not the Certificate of Achievement (16 to fewer than 30 units). No certificate section appears in the text, so no blocks were recorded.

The A.S. section lists ACCT 12, ACCT 101, ACCT 102, ACCT 105, ACCT 109, BUS 123, BUS 140, BUS 142, BUS 150, BUS 211 or BUS 212, CIS 101, CIS 133, and one of BUS 290-293 (2 units). The closed list matches this minus BUS 123, BUS 140 and BUS 150, summing to 28 units, which suggests the certificate is a subset of the A.S. A reviewer should locate the certificate's own catalog page.

The A.S. section prints Program Student Learning Outcomes and a career statement (junior members of the accounting staff of a private business or industrial enterprise, a public accounting firm, or a governmental agency); these were not recorded because they are printed for the A.S. degree, not the certificate.
